_about: Expected GitHub Actions OIDC trust policies for every AWS role a spore-host/spawn workflow assumes (#1601), in the format of spore-host/spore-host infra/iam/github-oidc/trusts.json (spore-host#709), which lists the same two roles with the same trusts. Neither role's trust is applied from this file: compare a live `aws iam get-role` against it with scripts/oidctrust (README.md). No account may appear here that spawn's forbiddenTrustAccounts refuses (942542972736).

roles.why: spawn's release, run by pushing a v* tag. It holds kms:Sign on the spored signing key (signing-key.json), so it is the authenticity root of every spored and bootstrap body. A tag push's sub is ref:refs/tags/<tag>, so the one wildcard allowed is the tag name, under StringLike. Anyone who can create a v* tag in spawn can assume this role, so a tag ruleset must restrict v* creation (README.md).
Approval-gated Lambda deploy. The job runs in the production environment (required reviewer, v* tags only), so the sub names the environment, not a ref.
